content: The value of the EcucContainerDef . postBuildVari- antMultiplicity attribute in the VSMD in case it is set to false in the StMD If the EcucModuleDef . postBuildVariantSupport is set to true and the postBuildVariantMultiplicity attribute of an EcucContainerDef in this EcucModuleDef in the StMD is set to false , the corresponding VSMD may set it to either false or true (if [constr_5506] is fulfilled).
